review_outcome: Completed the narrative V1 service lane end to end: the service boundary now owns source scouting, deterministic candidate seeding, optional OpenAI-backed candidate curation, candidate mapping proposals, narrative-evidence synthesis, merged review packaging, and a dedicated acceptance script, while keeping durable registry and mapping writes human-gated.

verification.minimax_curator_smoke: passed with provider=minimax-narrative-curator and one generated candidate under outputs/minimax_narrative_smoke

decisions.decision: Keep provider fetching in orchestrator for the first slice, and move only registry/mapping/evidence/signal assembly behind the service boundary.
decisions.rationale: This establishes the new runtime boundary without coupling the first cut to provider-routing or source-expansion refactors.

decisions.decision: Expose narrative-intelligence diagnostics as structured raw/scoring payload fields instead of changing report rendering in the first cut.
decisions.rationale: The acceptance target is pipeline boundary visibility first; report/UI presentation can consume the new diagnostics payload in later slices.

decisions.decision: Define low-confidence mappings as any mapping below 0.60 confidence or already marked needs_review.
decisions.rationale: This captures current fallback-derived ambiguity immediately while preserving exact higher-confidence mappings and avoiding scoring changes in the first cut.

decisions.decision: Keep generated narratives opt-in through an explicit pipeline flag while always emitting source-catalog and seed artifacts.
decisions.rationale: This preserves current default behavior for existing acceptance and report flows while making the new narrative lane fully runnable today.

decisions.decision: Use OpenAI structured output only as an optional curator layer and fall back to deterministic curation when no API key is present or the request fails.
decisions.rationale: The project keeps a no-dependency deterministic baseline while still enabling bounded AI abstraction when credentials are available.

decisions.decision: Prefer MiniMax as the default narrative curator in auto mode, using its Anthropic-compatible endpoint and falling back to OpenAI only when MiniMax credentials are absent.
decisions.rationale: This matches the intended default provider while preserving the same bounded JSON-only narrative curation contract and deterministic fallback path.
